run_benchmark_wav_plot: run the benchmark WAV plot script with --input and --output flags to generate a performance plot
run_plot_benchmark_results: run plot_benchmark_results to generate a QPS vs threads plot from a CSV benchmark file
run_parse_args: run _parse_args to parse command line arguments for input CSV, output path, and filter options
run_main: run main to load benchmark results from CSV and generate a performance comparison plot
review_plot_benchmark_results: review plot_benchmark_results function that groups benchmark data by label and plots QPS with confidence intervals
